correctness.rationale: The package reconstructs the \(30\) facets and \(790\) nonempty faces directly from the Petersen graph and the published definition. It verifies all \(390\) Morse pairs against the Hasse relation, checks acyclicity on all \(3510\) covers, and leaves exactly one critical \(0\)-cell and nine critical \(4\)-cells. Forman discrete Morse theory therefore gives a CW model with one \(0\)-cell and nine \(4\)-cells, hence a wedge of nine \(4\)-spheres. A separate mod-2 boundary-rank computation returns Betti vector \((1,0,0,0,9,0,0)\). Risk: the proof depends on the standard discrete-Morse theorem, not reproved in the package.

value.rationale: The object is mathematically motivated rather than an arbitrary slice: total cut complexes were introduced to connect graph structure, topology, and Stanley-Reisner phenomena, while the Petersen graph is a canonical symmetric nonchordal cubic graph outside the main computed families. The exact Morse result gives a full homotopy type and, because the complex is pure \(6\)-dimensional with homology in dimension \(4\), a natural non-shellability example. Risk: this is still a single-graph result and does not yet expose a general cubic-graph pattern.
